name: feature_register_feature

ownership.argument: Astrolink binds this as the entry that publishes its Feature. The function names itself in its failure logs, which is the primary evidence.

provenance.source: Validates that the description is non-null and that the registry instance exists, logging '[FEATURE] [%s:%d] description is null !' / 'Failed to get FeatureRegistry instance!' with the literal function name 'FeatureRegisterFeature' at feature_register_feature's own line numbers, then delegates to 0xC86E7C4. 32 call sites.
